name: youtube-embed-enhancer
description: Build scripts for the userscript. Source is in src/; the built file is youtube-embed-enhancer.user.js.

scripts.build:mediabunny: npm --prefix tools/mediabunny install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && node tools/mediabunny/build.mjs && npm run build
scripts.upgrade:mediabunny: npm --prefix tools/mediabunny install mediabunny@latest --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && node tools/mediabunny/build.mjs && npm run build
